headline: JSA advises PepsiCo on exclusive bottling arrangement with Varun Beverages
sum: PepsiCo extended Varun Beverages' exclusive bottling and trademark licence in India to 2049, and removed the exclusivity restriction on Varun.
detail: PepsiCo India Holdings executed a revised Exclusive Bottling Appointment and Trademark Licence Agreement with Varun Beverages. JSA advised PepsiCo. The bottling rights and licence to use PepsiCo's trademarks for a substantial part of India were extended by 10 years to 30 April 2049, and the restriction requiring Varun to operate solely for PepsiCo's business was removed. Varun Beverages is PepsiCo's anchor bottler in India.

sources.name: Bar & Bench — Dealstreet
sources.blurb: “PepsiCo India Holdings…has executed a revised Exclusive Bottling Appointment and Trademark Licence Agreement with Varun Beverages…extended…till April 30, 2049.” — confirms JSA's role and the Kartik Jain team.
